gui.xaero_wm_box_cave_mode_type:
Switch between two modes, saved per dimension. Every dimension returns to Normal (Auto) when you join a world. 
 
 Normal (Auto) - shows the surface; switches to the cave view automatically when there is a ceiling above you and around you underground 
 Partial Layer - always shows the cave view 
 
 The cave view shows 30 layers down from the first ceiling block above your head (at most 4 blocks above your feet) and cannot be adjusted. Applies to the minimap as well. You can also bind "Toggle Cave Mode (Normal / Partial Layer)" in Controls.
